title: Third-generation foldable iPhone said to feature larger displays
description: Apple is yet to unveil its first foldable iPhone, but a new report claims the company is already planning its second- and third-generation successors. Apple's first foldable, rumored to be called the iPhone Ultra, is expected to debut this September. In the latest edition of his Power On newsletter, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman claims that Apple is already planning a second-gen foldable iPhone for 2027. title: Moto G Max is coming to India with a Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 and 7,000mAh battery

title: Weekly poll: do you use a feature phone? Why?
description: Feature phones are making a comeback – is this just a fad (like Gen Z folks running around with point-and-shoot cameras) or is this a genuine trend on the market, a pushback against the all-capable, all-consuming smartphone? Now, the term “feature phone” was never clearly defined and is even murkier now. So to be clear as to what we mean, we mean phones that deliberately restrict their own capabilities. description: Samsung is rumored to unveil the Galaxy A18 in the coming weeks. While there's no word from the Korean brand about the Galaxy A18 yet, the smartphone has appeared on Geekbench, which reveals its key specs. title: Weekly poll results: smart glasses are a solution looking for a problem
description: Tech giants are spending tons of R&D money on building new smart glasses that fill various categories. However, based on the results from last week’s poll, all of them are solutions looking for a problem. The outcome couldn’t be more clear – the vast majority of voters are not using smart glasses. To be fair, regional availability is preventing some people from trying them out. But even then it’s clear that most people haven’t found a compelling use-case for them.
